newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Eritrean boat sinks with 95 people -- radio.
newsitem.headline: Eritrean boat sinks with 95 people -- radio.

text.p: A boat carrying 95 people sank off Eritrea and most people aboard were presumed dead, Eritrean radio said on Sunday.

The radio, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC), said six people survived and 18 of the passengers had been identified as Eritreans. The boat was en route for Saudi Arabia just across the Red Sea when it sank on Tuesday shortly after setting out.
A local government source said the boat was carrying 50 more people than it should have and that the vessel was planning to go to Saudi Arabia "illegally."
The search for bodies was underway but chances of finding more survivors was small, the radio said. Eleven bodies were recovered on Saturday but the total number found to date was unclear.
